nl: 部门员工台账：表格展示部门、小组、姓名、职位；同一个部门的行把「部门」这一列合并成一个单元格。支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Department staff ledger: the table lists department, team, name and role; rows of the same department merge into a single cell in the Department column. Supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-23: 顶层 mergeConfig.rowsBy 单列 → 生成器发射到 schema.tableOptions.mergeConfig（此前无此键，三端无合并能力）
